training_data_source: ESA WorldCover v200 2021 used as ground-truth labels, remapped to 4 classes; Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized (2023 median composite) used for feature bands. Sampled across 8 regions: Delhi_NCR_urban, Jaipur_urban_arid, Punjab_cropland, Thar_desert_bare, Chilika_lake_water, Western_Ghats_veg, Mumbai_dense_urban, Ganga_floodplain_mixed.
notes: Trained in Colab via train_model_colab.py using WorldCover-derived labels for traceability. v2: added B12, BSI, and TEXTURE features specifically to reduce the Built-up/Bare-Land confusion observed in v1 (v1 accuracy: 73.85%, with Built-up recall 60% and Bare Land recall 62.5% — the two weakest classes, frequently confused with each other).
